outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the exact identity and rendering reference for ONE original tactical-game group sprite: the compact dark gray-olive Mirehorn beast and its small masked reed-cloaked handler at screen LEFT. Preserve the reference's restrained dark painterly texture, narrow skull faceplate, original body length and height, two crescent horns, four clawed paws, reed cargo, bone harness, orange lantern sizes and attachments, tiny handler proportions, staff in the same hand and connected black chain rein in the other. Do not upscale the anatomy, enlarge its head or paws, brighten colors, add gloss, redesign gear or mirror the view. Fixed three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. Retain original torso position and scale.
Edit ONLY the articulated leg pose and handler stride for a restrained heavy walking passing frame. Lift the NEAR FOREPAW (large paw below the shoulder at center-right), bending its elbow and bringing it slightly forward, with a clear small gap beneath it. Lift the FAR HIND paw beneath the belly. Keep the OTHER TWO paws planted: far forepaw at screen-right and near hindpaw at screen-left. Exactly four complete anatomically connected legs, no missing supporting leg. Handler advances its screen-right boot with knee bent and foot lifted; screen-left boot planted. Torso and head stay steady, no leap or rear. One full isolated group only, not a sheet. Preserve all silhouette extremities within generous 10 percent blank margins. Flat pure chroma green #00ff00 background including all apertures, no gradient, checkerboard, floor, shadows, text, effects or extra objects.

notes: 11 packed candidate frames: eight retained paintings (including the previously corrected planted second idle) and three selected new paintings from four new built-in masters.

Initial assembly exposed that earlier isolated near/far passing and far-contact masters, and the earlier extracted ram contact, were much brighter and broader than the base sheet. They remain preserved unselected. Rebuilding from the fixed base identity produces closer body/palette continuity instead of attempting to recolor or warp them.

Two new movement frames alternate lifted diagonal paws and handler boot support. A planted frame separates them; this is a short-step candidate, not accepted translated gait. Exactly four paws are visible in each selected new movement painting.

The first new matched ram obscures its far foreleg and is unselected. Targeted built-in correction reveals a separate planted far forepaw beneath the jaw while preserving the other three paws, braced handler and connected chain/staff. The selected contact keeps the mouth closed.

Original RGB checker and corrected idle use connected neutral155/tolerance14/edge2 with explicit inspected seeds in chain/reed/arm/leg gaps. Previous extracted contact has real alpha that composites clean; no rekey applied to it. It is unselected for continuity rather than its raw transparent RGB.

Original handler remains in every selected frame. Retained kneel/side-fall/persistent corpse includes prone handler and dark final lanterns/eyes. Crop bands exclude neighboring horn/lantern/paw fragments and disconnected hit crescent without deleting owned equipment.

New selected green masters use distance75/edge2. Horn curvature, mask/harness/lantern scale and attachment, handler grip/rein length, paw support and translated movement, edges and actual battle timing remain for full-roster refinement. Production previews are not acceptance. No tests/imports/exports or gameplay/save/footprint changes.
